'''November 2001 Pennsylvania Episode I tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Twilight Games, Pennsylvania on 17 November 2001. It is known from Rypcord Kline's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3103">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-17-twilight-games-pa-11-17-01d3103/ twilight-games-pa-11-17-01], DeckTech (Rypcord "Rypcord" Kline, 17 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-17-twilight-games-pa-11-17-01d3103/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Twilight Games, Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
